sourceChecks.result: Reviewed the ancient and Warring-States historical survey passages: Qi Huan and Guan Zhong, Jin Wen, Lu Cheng/Ai, Confucius and Zilu, the Sun/Wu/Shang/Yan exempla, legendary rulers, Chu Zhao and Helu, Bai Qi/Wang Jian, and Yi Yin/Lu Wang. These are historical comparisons or named precedents, not source-backed Western life-date attestations.

Reviewed the Han-founding and earlier legal-history comparisons. Phrases such as 漢興, 武帝時, 元帝時, 穆王時, 春秋之時, 戰國, and 孝惠、高后時 remain verbatim source context, but the packet contains no separate research evidence justifying the derived Western points or whole-reign intervals as each named person's active chronology.

Reviewed the local legal-history narration, including Wen's thirteenth year, Jing's first/middle years, and imperial-era references. The underlying dated occurrences and named actors remain fully visible in the holds; the proposed repair properly declines to treat an uncited conversion or a reign-wide interval as a personal life chronology.

Reviewed the later comparative/statistical discussion: Gao/Hui, the Zhao-through-Ping six-reign aggregate, Cheng Hongjia, Cheng/Ai comparison, Confucius, Xun Qing, King Wu, and Cheng/Kang. These passages are aggregate reign references, quotations, or historical models; all dates remain source-specific unresolved context rather than unsupported personal Western active dates.
